correctness.rationale: Exact chain reduction checks all 220 vertex triples and proves all 176 empty triangles are nonzero in H1(F2), with 110 classes and multiplicities 1:56, 2:48, 4:6. Link-cycle exhaustion proves the full automorphism group has order 12 and computes the complete class-orbit profile. The published orientable genus-six identification plus the standard mod-two separation criterion converts nonzero class into nonseparating loop.

value.rationale: The empty triangles are exactly the first possible nonfacial simple loops in a neighborly triangulation. Showing that all 176 are nonseparating settles the complete length-three topological layer, while the exact 110-class multiplicity and symmetry-orbit structure reveal how those systoles occupy H1 rather than merely recounting faces.
